Start close to home: Lancaster and Chester counties in Pennsylvania, then the Jersey Shore and Delmarva counties named in the add-on screen. National counties come later. The county base table's ranked results are not in this context, so this answer cannot give a nationwide county ranking.

What the plan prioritises

  • Phase 1 (months 0-12) fills the 248 core Central-PA ZIP codes and the 261 best nearby ZIP codes: 176 in PA and 85 in MD (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
  • Phase 2 (months 9-24) repeats the Horvath deal across PA, NJ, MD, DE and southern NY. That region has 54 mapped Authority territories that Punctual Pros does not own (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).

# Where Punctual Pros should expand first

Start close to home: Lancaster and Chester counties in Pennsylvania, then the Jersey Shore and Delmarva counties named in the add-on screen. National counties come later. The county base table's ranked results are not in this context, so this answer cannot give a nationwide county ranking.

## What the plan prioritises

- **Phase 1 (months 0-12)** fills the 248 core Central-PA ZIP codes and the 261 best nearby ZIP codes: 176 in PA and 85 in MD (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- **Phase 2 (months 9-24)** repeats the Horvath deal across PA, NJ, MD, DE and southern NY. That region has 54 mapped Authority territories that Punctual Pros does not own (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- **Phase 3 (months 18-36)** adds Baltimore-DC, Richmond, the Philadelphia suburbs and Pittsburgh (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- Truly national county choices belong to Phase 4. That phase targets the wider One Hour / Ben Franklin / Mister Sparky system, where Punctual Pros holds about 2.3% today (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).

## First counties, by target evidence

## Why this order holds up

- Across 11 dated cases, sponsors closed their first add-on a median of about 7 months after entry. Later tuck-ins came every three to five months (value creation cases). Nearby counties keep that pace realistic.
- The plan's KPI roadmap assumes two tuck-ins worth about $10M of acquired revenue by month 12 (est., Punctual Pros nationwide plan).

## Gaps before naming counties nationwide

- **County scoring:** a ranked extract of the national county table is needed. It should cover housing units, heating and cooling demand, Redfin turnover and Authority outlet counts.
- **Connecticut:** heating/cooling, Redfin and Authority fields are null for CT, so CT counties cannot be scored yet (national counties).
- **Target size:** revenue and employee counts are missing for most targets because ZoomInfo enrichment was unavailable (Punctual Pros add-on targets).

## Next actions

- Pull the top-ranked counties from the national county table, filtered to PA, NJ, MD, DE and southern NY. Overlay the 54 unowned Authority territories.
- Open founder conversations with Lancaster Plumbing and the Ron Williams group, which covers both Chester County and Delmarva.
- Fill in revenue and headcount for the top ten targets through broker contacts or site visits.
- Build a CT crosswalk from planning regions to legacy counties before any scoring of New England counties.
